NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1 no_proxy=localhost,127.0.0.1 ./venv/bin/python -c "
import hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
ds = project.get_dataset_api()
path = ds.upload('data/heartbeat.py', 'Resources', overwrite=True)
print('uploaded:', path)
jobs_api = project.get_job_api()
cfg = jobs_api.get_configuration('PYTHON')
cfg['appPath'] = path
job = jobs_api.create_job('heartbeat3d28a3', cfg)
print('job created:', job.name, job.job_type)
sched = job.schedule(cron_expression='0 0 * * * ?')
print('schedule:', sched.cron_expression, 'enabled:', sched.enabled, 'next:', sched.next_execution_date_time)
" 2>&1 | grep -v 'INFO:'
